attributes.name: Mask of the Mesmerists
attributes.powers: When you encounter a monster from a location deck, display this card next to that deck and put the monster face up on top of this card. The monster is neither defeated nor undefeated; it counts as the top card of the location deck except for the purposes of exploring. At the end of the turn, put the monster on top of its location deck and bury this card.
